name: Utah Ice Cubing 2023

venue.name: [Utah Valley Convention Center](https://utahvalleycc.com/)
venue.address: 220 West Center Street, Suite 200 Provo UT, 84601

information: * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * No outside food and drink is allowed in the venue. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with much of the information you need. * All first-time competitors should be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.
